commands.summary: The Phase 04 working tree is formatted and has no diff whitespace errors.
All 75 host API tests passed, including the retired-400 decode and bit-32 compatibility proof.

commands.command: cargo check -p vicell-kernel -p api -p ostd --target riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf; release kernel builds for riscv64, aarch64, and x86_64
commands.summary: The affected libraries and all supported release-kernel targets compiled.
Fresh release cells, 42 signed cells, kernel_fs.img, and disk_v3.img were rebuilt; optional tetris-lua was omitted and the tracked embedded init ELF was refreshed from app-init.
All 15 hotswap integration cases passed, including FIFO cutover, SpawnCap retention, state preservation, and unauthorized direct sender denial.
The launch-profile integration case passed and retained the Supervisor-routed snapshot authority proof.

commands.command: x86 and AArch64 fresh-boot QEMU gates
commands.summary: Windows/WSL path conversion prevented fresh x86 ISO and AArch64 disk packaging; neither boot lane is claimed as passed.
The lane executed 75 tests but measured 33.26 percent line and 0 percent branch coverage; bare-metal kernel paths remain covered by QEMU integration evidence rather than this host metric.

beforeAfter.before: SpawnCap callers could invoke the legacy kernel HotSwap syscall 400 and the kernel owned a duplicated whole-sequence orchestrator.
beforeAfter.after: Opcode 400 is reserved and decodes Unknown; Supervisor IPC is the sole hotswap orchestrator while kernel mechanisms remain available behind their existing authority gates.
